o.text: From Proto-Turkic *es-(kü). Cognate with Old Turkic [script needed] (eski); Turkish eski, etc.

From Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (tapšurmaq). Cognate with Turkish tapşırmak, Uzbek topshirmoq (“to deliver, hand over, present”), Uyghur تاپشۇرماق (tapshurmaq), Kyrgyz тапшыр (tapşır, “to hand over; to assign”).
From iç (“the inner part”) + -alat as a pseudo-Arabic derivation. Compare gedişat.
From boyun (“neck”) and boy (“stature, height”) + -lan. Perhaps merger with an earlier *boyunlamaq by contamination.
